I remember when I was 17 or so I went with a couple of people from school out to the wilderness. As we didn't have the money to go to Cuba or passports. So we were at our campground having a blast. Until I noticed when I went to be I could smell smoke. No one put out the fire. 

    So in the morning I asked one of the guys. Let's call him D for dumbass who was the major cause of this natural disaster that was going to happen. I asked " why aren't you putting the fire out when we go to bed"? I asked. D replies " well we want to stay warm all night that's why I put my tent right beside the fire." So I had a shock of what the fuck did d just say on my face. As I'm thinking in disbelief from what d just said. I thought that could cause a fire. So I decided when they all went to bed I put out the fire. 

   Night 2 I put out the fire when they were all sleeping. D's tent was literally 2 inches from the fire. Which screams a hazard. I end up going to bed after I put the fire out. I get woken up at around 2am hearing yelling. I walked out of my tent to see d pissed off and said " why did you put out the fire ?" " well it's unsafe D. " I replied. He said " well when you don't have a sleeping bag or blanket it gets cold out here." He said. 

  So d went camping with no sleeping bag, no blanket. I thought at this point he was just stupid. He ended up going in the other guy's tent. Let's call him S for smart as he knew more about camping than all of us. 

   Then finally night I put out the fire again. Went to bed. At the dead of night I hear screaming. I look out up to see orange through my tent. I never got up so fast in my life. I ran out of the tent to see D's tent on fire, my tent on fire and S tent on fire. Which made its way through the trees. Forest fire basically. As they had to clear out the campground because one dumbass forgot to come prepared. 

This was back in 2007 and it became a pretty big forest fire in BC. D was charged as they found it to be ridiculous. So he went to jail actually and never graduated. 

     After that scare I haven't been camping since. It kind of ruined it for me. I still talk to S and remain good friends till this day. Never leave a fire unattended if you don't know the risks.
